name: Go Direct
tagline: Interviews founders until the story sounds like them, then helps place it.
description: Rather than ghostwriting polished copy, this one questions you - the product, the vision, why it matters - until the story shows up sounding like you. It then helps place that story with the people who count: first investors, early buyers, wanted hires. The method comes from a founder-comms playbook, not the press.
author: LandonH
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
